name: Kasagi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kasagi town emblem in white: an outlined ring with a winged bar enclosing a stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Kasagi, a town in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 March 1970.

features.role: Kasagi town emblem — an outlined ring with a winged bar enclosing a stylised device
